title: Create solution from prioritization — create_solution_from_prioritization
text: argument settings must list following elements. "features" data.frame theme feature settings. used specify targets weights considered features optimization. row corresponds different feature, must following columns: "id", "name", "column", "zone", "target", "weight". Note target values must expressed proportion (.e., value zero one). "locks" data.frame settings specify locks used lock planning units particular zone. row corresponds different lock, must following columns: "id", "name", "column", "zone", "priority". "costs" data.frame cost settings. used specify costs considered zone. row corresponds different cost, must following columns: "id", "name", "zone", "weight". "zones" data.frame settings multi-objective optimization. row corresponds different zone, must following columns: "name" "weight".
